title: Mafia enforcement in Malmgren's Rhode Island childhood

tellings.quote: Couple of guys would be guys would come in, grab him, take him out, beat the out of him. [laughter]

plain: A former advisor to US presidents named Harold Malmgren tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about growing up in Rhode Island in the 1940s, around Providence and Narragansett Bay. He says that mafia enforcers would come in, grab a man, take him outside and beat him badly, and he laughs as he recalls it. He tells it as a picture of the rough world he came from.
